description: Get the token budget of this NewsAPI.ai account: tokens available, used and remaining for the current period. Call it before a batch of searches (measured costs: search_articles and get_article 1 token, search_events and get_event info 5, get_trending_concepts 10). Free: does not consume tokens itself. Suggest tools are free too. Also reports this server’s session budget (NEWSAPI_AI_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SESSION, default 200): calls that would exceed it fail locally without reaching the API.
name: get_usage
